debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technical confluence (RSI rising, MACD bullish crossover, Supertrend bullish) with price near support (19.29) offers tactical entry for mean-reversion trade if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (VIX 291, inverted yield curve, CPI imminent), fundamental conviction is absent (score 2), intermediate trend structure is broken (below EMA 20/50 and 200-SMA), and ADX weakness (18) indicates insufficient trend strength to sustain a swing move.

decision.primary_risk: Macro shock from CPI event or continued VIX elevation could trigger sharp reversal below support (19.29), invalidating technical setup and trapping swing entry.
